description: Per-character break-fall timing: when knock-down/blow actions may be cancelled into a break-fall, and how long the recovery is protected by collision lock 6.

Id.simple: Character action row key, normally the character ID (for example CP_010).
Id.technical: Unreal DataTable row name. After the CharacterDataTable row resolves ActionDataTable, ActionDataTable.Id_ActionBreakFall is used as the FindRow key against ActionBreakFallDataTables; the table is loaded under the exact name ActionBreakFallDataTable. The exported table contains one row, CP_010.

Down_CancelInput_Time.simple: Earliest time a knocked-down character can break-fall.
Down_CancelInput_Time.technical: Seconds. FGameCharacterAction_Down::CanBreakFall passes this to BlowCancelInputElapsed; a value >= 0 enables the test and cancel is allowed only once Elapsed >= value. A negative value permanently disables the cancel. C++ constructor default is 0.0f; exported CP_010 uses -1.0 (disabled).

Blow_CancelInput_Time.simple: Earliest time a blown-away character can break-fall.
Blow_CancelInput_Time.technical: Seconds, using the same BlowCancelInputElapsed rule as Down_CancelInput_Time; negative disables. Blow additionally refuses if the owner is defeated or wall-bound. Constructor default 0.0f; exported CP_010 is 1.1.

BlowSmall_CancelInput_Time.simple: Earliest time after a small blow can be cancelled into break-fall.
BlowSmall_CancelInput_Time.technical: Seconds, same >= 0 threshold/negative-disables rule and defeated/wall-bound guards as Blow_CancelInput_Time. Constructor default 0.0f; exported CP_010 is 0.8.

BlowLarge_CancelInput_Time.simple: Earliest time after a large blow can be cancelled into break-fall.
BlowLarge_CancelInput_Time.technical: Seconds, same >= 0 threshold/negative-disables rule and defeated/wall-bound guards. Constructor default 0.0f; exported CP_010 is 2.0.

Invincible_Time.technical: Seconds. FGameCharacterAction_BreakFall::End only calls SetCollisionLock(6, true, Invincible_Time) when the value is > 0; zero/negative means no lock. Constructor default 0.0f; exported CP_010 is 0.0.

notes: One exported asset was available (CP_010); the source has no variant/localization copies of this table. Do not generalise the exported values to every character.
C++ evidence comes from the reconstructed Abrams source, not a claim of retail byte-match; only the listed direct consumers were identifiable in the available Source/Plugins.
The export writes the row key as ID while the reconstructed USTRUCT property is Id; consumers use it as a FindRow key rather than reading a separate value field.

usages.detail: ResolveDataRows looks up ActionBreakFallDataTables with ActionDataTable.Id_ActionBreakFall and stores the row on the character.
Shared BlowCancelInputElapsed helper: negative times disable the cancel; otherwise the cancel opens at Elapsed >= threshold.
Blow break-fall eligibility uses Blow_CancelInput_Time, with defeated/wall-bound guards.
BlowSmall break-fall eligibility uses BlowSmall_CancelInput_Time, with defeated/wall-bound guards.
BlowLarge break-fall eligibility uses BlowLarge_CancelInput_Time, with defeated/wall-bound guards.
BreakFall::End tests Invincible_Time > 0 before applying collision lock 6 for that duration.
